exercises.q: Fadil resorted to a desperate measure.
exercises.why: **прибегнул** — прибе́гнуть (perfective): to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon). Wiktionary: при- + бегнуть.

exercises.why: **прибегнуть** — прибе́гнуть (perfective): to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon). Wiktionary: при- + бегнуть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon)
asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter)
to get by running or as if by running
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: прибе́гнуть — to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon); убе́жище — asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter); побе́г — flight, escape; забежа́ть — to get by running or as if by running.

exercises.q: I came by to say hi.
exercises.why: **забежал** — забежа́ть (perfective): to get by running or as if by running; to run ahead (in anticipation), to run before someone; (colloquial) to visit, to drop in. Wiktionary: за- + бежа́ть.

incursion, raid, foray (of barbarians, nomads, gangs, etc.)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: добежа́ть — to run (to; as far as), to reach; избе́гнуть — to avoid, to refrain from; набе́г — incursion, raid, foray (of barbarians, nomads, gangs, etc.); неизбе́жность — inevitability.
